notes: Limits updater-generated pre-update rollback ZIPs to the newest two valid backups by default.
Automatically removes zero-byte, corrupt, and older updater backup artifacts after a successful backup is created.
Writes pre-update backups to a temporary file and validates the ZIP before atomically promoting it to a rollback backup.
Adds ARMORY_UPDATE_BACKUP_RETENTION for optional retention tuning while defaulting to two backups.
